sections.text: Newsroom JLC Digital Manufacturing Achieves PCI DSS v4.0.1 Level 1 Certification JLC Digital Manufacturing has achieved Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS) v4.0.1 Level 1 certification, the highest level of PCI DSS compliance. The certification covers the company's major overseas business platforms, including JLCCNC, JLCPCB, JLC3DP, and JLCMC, reinforcing payment security and data protection for customers worldwide.
